title: Houthis Claim They Downed Saudi Fighter Jet After Being Accused of Targeting Mecca
summary: The Iran-backed militia in Yemen made its claim hours after a Saudi-led military coalition accused it of firing a drone near the Muslim holy city. The Houthis denied doing so.
